name: scroll-float
title: Scroll Float
description: Letters of a display line rise and settle into place one by one, driven by scroll position, so scrolling back reverses it.

meta.reducedMotion: Letters sit in place; no scroll listener runs.
meta.useWhen: Play-mood display lines that should feel buoyant; one line per section.
meta.avoidWhen: Serious or institutional briefs; text that must be readable before it settles (prices, dates).
